items.text: Verify all 3 subagent features present in main workspace
Add durable brick-colors test adapted to main render implementation
Run full test suite and frame-profiler gate

event.text:
All three parallel tasks are complete and integrated in the main workspace — nothing remains running.

### What was spawned
Three write-capable subagents were launched in parallel, each with `worktree_isolation` in its own git worktree from base `10255fac`:

- **(1) High-score persistence** — `main/High-score persistence/1` (`01a132f4-724a-72e3-b980-bd263ec8042f`)
- **(2) Multi-colored bricks by row** — `main/Multi-colored bricks by row/2` (`01a132f4-7498-7930-8887-4c6064329af6`)
- **(3) Combo multiplier scoring** — `main/Combo multiplier scoring/3` (`01a132f4-76c8-7821-88c7-ca7cc1a9a00f`)

All three reached `result_ready` (confirmed via `subagent_status`); their worktrees were retained dirty and not auto-applied, so I verified the integration already present in the parent instead of re-spawning anything.

### Integrated results in the main workspace
- **High-score persistence:** [game/highscore.py](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/game/highscore.py) stores `{"high_score": N}` in `highscore.json` (git-ignored), loads as `0` on missing/corrupt/invalid data, saves atomically and only for a new best. [main.py](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/main.py) loads it on startup and persists on game-over and on quit; the HUD shows `HIGH`. Covered by [tests/test_highscore.py](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/tests/test_highscore.py).
- **Multi-colored bricks:** [game/render.py:14](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/game/render.py:14) maps rows via `_BRICK_IMGS` (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, pink, grey from `assets/bricks/`, cycling with `b.row % len(...)`).
- **Combo multiplier:** [game/engine.py](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/game/engine.py) tracks `combo`/`combo_multiplier` (Nth consecutive hit scores N× base, capped at `COMBO_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 5` in [game/config.py:59](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/game/config.py:59)); a missed player shot off the top or being hit resets it, and the HUD shows `COMBO xN`. Covered by [tests/test_combo.py](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/tests/test_combo.py).

### Remaining work completed this turn
The bricks feature was the only one without durable coverage in the main workspace, so I added [tests/test_brick_colors.py](/Users/dev/CodeIntegrity/bastion_breaker/tests/test_brick_colors.py), adapted to the main `_BRICK_IMGS` implementation: it asserts each of the 4 wall rows uses a distinct existing `assets/bricks/` sprite and that headless rendering produces a distinct centre colour per row.

Verification: the full suite passes (`38 passed`, up from 36) and the repo's frame-profiler gate passes headless — `RESULT: PASS (p95 6.65ms < 8.00ms budget)` via `npx --yes frame-profiler --suite engine` (run with a writable `npm_config_cache=/tmp/npm-cache-frameprof` because the default `~/.npm` cache is root-owned).
